description: Election Commission - M. A. M. Rahman was Selected as the member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes, making it an Elections Gazette.
